g.text: Food Rescue Platform (Replate) - Delivery & Dual-Party Handover Verification Workflow
Hand over food containers to Driver
Review Food Details, Pickup & Dropoff Stops
Enter verified quantity in Mobile App
Present food cargo for intake inspection
Input received quantity and condition notes
Calculate route to Recipient NGO facility
Compute impact metric (kg rescued, CO2 avoided)
Flag alert to Quality Assurance Operations
Broadcast completion event to all parties
Track incoming delivery on live map
